Francis Hauksbee.depiction_note: 豪克斯比于1708—1709年制造的气泵，现藏伦敦科学博物馆；这是相关实验仪器图，不是本人肖像。
Francis Hauksbee.depiction_note_en: An air pump made by Francis Hauksbee in 1708–1709, exhibited at the Science Museum, London. This is a related instrument, not a portrait.

Thomas Harriot.depiction_note: 传统上被认为是哈里奥特的1602年男子画像，但人物归属未获证实；画面年龄题记为32岁，与其约1560年出生不符。作为有争议的历史资料图保留，不视为已确认的本人肖像。
Thomas Harriot.depiction_note_en: A 1602 painting traditionally associated with Harriot, but the sitter is unverified. Its inscription gives an age of 32, inconsistent with his birth around 1560. Retained as a disputed historical illustration, not an authenticated portrait of Harriot.

Georgy Flerov.depiction_note: 2013年俄罗斯发行的弗廖罗夫诞辰百年纪念邮票；这是逝世后创作的纪念性形象。保留完整邮票，不将头像部分单独裁切使用。
Georgy Flerov.depiction_note_en: A Russian postage stamp issued in 2013 for the centenary of Flerov’s birth; this is a posthumous commemorative depiction. Retain the whole stamp rather than extracting the portrait alone.

Clyde Cowan.depiction_note: 克莱德·科万（左）与弗雷德里克·莱因斯（右）的双人照片；不是单人头像。
Clyde Cowan.depiction_note_en: Clyde Cowan at left with Frederick Reines at right; this is a two-person photograph rather than a solo headshot.

Bryce DeWitt.depiction_note: 布赖斯·德威特站在右侧，塞西尔·德威特-莫雷特坐在左侧；这是一张合影。
Bryce DeWitt.depiction_note_en: Bryce DeWitt stands at right; Cécile DeWitt-Morette is seated at left. This is a group photograph.

Shirley Ann Jackson.depiction_note: 雪莉·安·杰克逊身穿红衣位于左侧，与奥巴马总统同框接受美国国家科学奖章。图片在Commons所列开放许可受到质疑，2026年5月5日起被提请删除；网站再发布授权尚未确认。
Shirley Ann Jackson.depiction_note_en: Shirley Ann Jackson, wearing red at left, receives the National Medal of Science from President Obama. The Commons free-licence claim is disputed in a deletion nomination dated 5 May 2026; website republication permission has not been verified.
Shirley Ann Jackson.license: Copyright or reuse permission unverified; consult the original image record and audit note

Rolf Landauer.depiction_note: 兰道尔的1969年本人照片。Commons列有“Copyrighted free use”标签，但本轮未核实AIP原图的逐图再发布授权，故保留为需确认授权。
Rolf Landauer.depiction_note_en: A photograph of Landauer from 1969. Commons lists “Copyrighted free use”, but item-specific permission from the AIP source was not verified in this audit; website republication remains subject to permission.
Rolf Landauer.license: Copyright or reuse permission unverified; consult the original image record and audit note

Artur Ekert.depiction_note: 埃克特的本人照片裁切版；原图须署名The Royal Society并依CC BY-SA 3.0使用，Commons裁切版另列CC BY-SA 4.0，发布时保留原始署名及两级来源。
Artur Ekert.depiction_note_en: A cropped photograph of Ekert. The source requires attribution to The Royal Society under CC BY-SA 3.0; Commons lists the crop under CC BY-SA 4.0. Preserve the original attribution and both source and crop licence information.
Artur Ekert.credit: The Royal Society; original uploaded by Duncan.Hull; cropped by Ravenpuff (2023). Original: CC BY-SA 3.0; crop: CC BY-SA 4.0.

Marin Mersenne.depiction_note: 由克洛德·迪弗洛（1665—1727）制作的梅森后世版画；版画家出生时梅森已经逝世，不能视为生前写生肖像。
Marin Mersenne.depiction_note_en: A later engraving of Mersenne by Claude Duflos (1665–1727), who was born after Mersenne’s death in 1648; this is a posthumous depiction.

Félix Savart.depiction_note: 位于巴黎法兰西学会的萨伐尔半身雕塑的现代照片。配图是雕塑肖像，不是本人的历史照片；尚未核实雕塑是否依据生前写生。
Félix Savart.depiction_note_en: A modern photograph of the named bust of Félix Savart at the Institut de France in Paris. This is a sculptural portrait, not a historical photograph of Savart; whether it was modelled during his lifetime has not been verified.
